_schema.purpose: Recipe index for the BrewPage Cookbook. One row per recipe; consumed by the repo README and (future) cookbook landing.
_schema.shape: recipes[]: { slug, title, status, lang[], dir, liveUrl, liveLink, description, crossLinks{ platform, ecosystem } }
rules: liveUrl is a placeholder until a recipe is published; the real short URL is assigned by BrewPage at publish and pasted back here.

liveLink is the canonical https://brewpage.app/public/<id> URL; filled from recipes/<slug>/.brewpage-site.json by .claude/scripts/stamp-url.mjs at publish. Until then it carries the REPLACE_AT_PUBLISH placeholder.
crossLinks are mandatory on every recipe (mandatory cross-link rule): both platform and ecosystem must be present.

recipes.title: RAG Guide
recipes.description: Long-form interactive walkthrough of retrieval-augmented generation: one route from 0% to 100% across 12 pages, with inline-SVG drill-down diagrams, mini-games, calculators and client-side search. Bilingual (RU default, EN-ready); RU prose is the authored manuscript. Doubles as the production dogfood for the publish pipeline.
